title: Bari Category Page Output v3
description: JSON Schema v3 — additive extension of v2 to reach milk content depth (TASK-262 / P43). v2 remains valid: all v2 fields are preserved unchanged. v3 adds 4 per-product content fields that match the milk-comparison.json gold standard: consumerTakeaway, consumerExplanation, bariInterpretation[], bestUseCases[]. schema_carries_milk_depth=TRUE.

x-version-history.v2: score type float-fix, comparisonContext required, extension fields documented
x-version-history.v3: milk-depth content extension (TASK-262/P43): +consumerTakeaway, +consumerExplanation, +bariInterpretation[], +bestUseCases[]. Nothing removed. v2 stays valid.

x-deterministic-vs-authored.description: v3 fields split by pipeline stage that fills them
deterministic: bariInterpretation[].label    — display label mapped from dimension key (DIMENSION_LABEL_MAP)
bestUseCases[]                — deterministic ONLY when a clean rule exists for the product; PENDING_COPY otherwise (most products)
authored: consumerTakeaway              — one-line authored summary (Content Agent / baseline placeholder)
consumerExplanation.whyRated  — authored sentence explaining the score
consumerExplanation.good[]    — authored list of observed strengths (richer than positiveSignals)
consumerExplanation.watchOut[]— authored list of caution signals
bestUseCases[]                — PENDING_COPY when no deterministic rule; author fills
x-deterministic-vs-authored.note: The factory emits PENDING_COPY for every authored field. merge_copy.py replaces them after the author_copy stage. A field that is PENDING_COPY in the final page = pipeline failure (0 PENDING required).

x-deviations.status: CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN optional — present when extension_fields includes '_subpool'
CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN optional — present when extension_fields includes '_isChildrens'
CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN optional — present when extension_fields includes '_wholeGrainClaim'
CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN optional — present when extension_fields includes '_internal_cluster'. Stripped by page-data layer before UI display.
OPTIONAL — present on some products only; not emitted by generator in Phase 1
OPTIONAL — present when category invariant applies; snacks category-level unknown
OPTIONAL — category-level string, present in snacks only

x-deviations.actual: number (float in both live JSONs, e.g. 76.0 displayed as 76, 82.3). Schema v1 was wrong.

x-deviations.v1_said: present in expansion.required — but not listed as required in v1 product.required
x-deviations.actual: present in all 42 granola and all 18 snacks products; REQUIRED in practice

x-deviations.note: bestUseCases is PENDING_COPY in the generator output for most products. It becomes deterministic only when a clean rule applies (e.g. additive_count=0 → 'רכיבים פשוטים'). The author fills PENDING slots in the author_copy stage.

product_count.description: Number of product objects in the products array

scored_count.description: Number of products with a non-null score (= run universe size)

config_sha256.description: SHA256 of the category config JSON used to produce this file

exclusions.description: Full list of barcodes excluded from display with reasons

retailer_breakdown.description: Map of retailer slug to product count

subpool_filter.description: Subpool filter applied (field + value), or null if not used

id.description: Unique product identifier (bsip1_<type>_<barcode> or snk-NNN format)

name.description: Hebrew product display name (must contain at least one Hebrew character)

imageUrl.description: Product image URL; null when unavailable

score.description: Bari score 0-100 as float (e.g. 76.0 or 82.3); null for INSUFFICIENT products. v1 incorrectly typed this as integer.

grade.description: Letter grade derived from score via boundary policy (floor default)

insightLine.description: One-line consumer insight. PENDING_COPY in Phase 1 generator output.

confidence.description: Data confidence level (3-state v2 + verified for milk)

d4_additives.description: D4 additive tier entries. Empty array when not gated.

nutrition.description: Per-100g nutrition values. All sub-fields nullable: null = data unavailable. Present on every product (may be all-null).

ingredients.description: Full ingredients text. Null when unavailable. NEVER sourced from OFF.

confidenceLabel.description: Pre-rendered Hebrew confidence label in expansion (mirrors confidence_label_he)

positiveSignals.description: 1-3 observable strengths (Hebrew strings). PENDING in Phase 1.

limitingFactors.description: 0-2 compositional limits (Hebrew strings). Absent when no limits identified. PENDING in Phase 1.

unknowns.description: Data gaps Bari could not verify (Hebrew). Category-level invariant (present in snacks).

caveats.description: Product-level caveats (Hebrew). Not yet present in any corpus.

bottomLine.description: Editorial synthesis (Hebrew). Present in snacks only. PENDING in Phase 1.

comparisonContext.description: Shelf-relative context without algorithm vocabulary (Hebrew). v1 listed in required but not product.required — now both. PENDING in Phase 1.

consumerExplanation.description: v3 AUTHORED: structured multi-part explanation (milk-depth). All sub-fields PENDING_COPY in generator output; authored in author_copy stage.

whyRated.description: AUTHORED. One sentence explaining why the product received its score. Grade badge only; no framework vocabulary.

good.description: AUTHORED. List of observed strengths (richer/longer than positiveSignals). Each is a complete Hebrew string.

watchOut.description: AUTHORED. List of caution signals. Each is a complete Hebrew string. Empty array when none.

context.description: AUTHORED. One sentence placing this product on the shelf vs peers (consumer framing).

takeaway.description: AUTHORED. Mirrors consumerTakeaway — the bottom-line consumer summary.

consumerTakeaway.description: v3 AUTHORED: one-line plain Hebrew summary at the product level. Equivalent to insightLine but named for milk-depth parity. PENDING_COPY in generator output; authored in author_copy stage.

bariInterpretation.description: v3 DETERMINISTIC+AUTHORED: per-dimension breakdown. key/label/score/strength are DETERMINISTIC from the BSIP2 trace. interpretation is AUTHORED (PENDING_COPY in generator). A missing/anomalous dimension emits null score + 'data not available'.

label.description: DETERMINISTIC. Consumer-facing Hebrew display label for this dimension.

score.description: DETERMINISTIC. Dimension score rounded to 1dp from trace.dimension_scores. null when missing/anomalous (guard: never fabricated).

strength.description: DETERMINISTIC. Strength bucket mapped from score: ≥80=חזק, ≥50=בינוני, <50=נמוך. 'data not available' when score is null.

interpretation.description: AUTHORED. One short Hebrew sentence explaining what this dimension score means for the consumer. PENDING_COPY in generator output.

bestUseCases.description: v3 DETERMINISTIC/AUTHORED: consumer use-case tags (Hebrew, e.g. 'חלבון', 'ילדים', 'רכיבים פשוטים'). Populated deterministically when a clean rule applies (e.g. no additives → 'רכיבים פשוטים'); PENDING_COPY otherwise.

rowVerdict.description: 2-3 sentence editorial verdict on the collapsed row. Category-level invariant (present in granola). PENDING in Phase 1.

rowReason.description: Short strongest +/- for collapsed row. Synthesized by page-data layer.

metrics.description: Display-only metric block. Synthesized by page-data layer.

d3_processing.description: D3 processing signal. Absent when not gated.

glassBox.description: Glass Box D5/D6 presentation state. Absent when not gated.

s_grade_explanation.description: Pre-authored Hebrew explanation for S-grade products. Absent on non-S grades.

_subpool.description: CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN. Subpool identifier (e.g. 'granola'). Present when extension_fields includes '_subpool'.

_isChildrens.description: CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN. Children's product flag. Present when extension_fields includes '_isChildrens'.

_wholeGrainClaim.description: CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN. Whole grain claim flag. Present when extension_fields includes '_wholeGrainClaim'.

_internal_cluster.description: CATEGORY-CONFIG-DRIVEN. Internal editorial cluster label (e.g. 'date-simple'). Stripped by page-data layer before UI display. Present when extension_fields includes '_internal_cluster'. Null when not yet assigned (Phase 1 generator — copy engine fills in Phase 2).

confidence_level.description: Optional confidence level string (e.g. 'sufficient'). Present in some granola products only.

rank.description: 1-based rank of this product within the displayed shelf (scored by Bari score descending). Present on every scored product. Whitelisted 2026-06-22 — ShelfContextSection component requires it; confirmed present on all live categories.

categoryTotal.description: Total number of displayed products in this category page. Used by ShelfContextSection to render 'X out of Y' shelf context. Whitelisted 2026-06-22 — confirmed present on all live categories.
